description: Na₃YSi₃(HO₂)₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.75 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.33 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-49°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-51°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-46°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Y, one Si, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Y, one Si, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, one Si, and one H atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
